# 📌 General Request Template

Use this template for any requests that don't fall under a fix, metric, or bug.  
This can include new features, data needs, tooling, or process improvements.  

---

## 🎯 Purpose  
Explain why this request is needed. What problem are you solving or what opportunity are you pursuing?  

**Example:**  
> The current zoning shapefiles are outdated and affect the accuracy of property type classification.  

---

## 🔧 Request Details  
Describe exactly what you're requesting. Include file paths, links, visual aids, or specific deliverables.  

**Example:**  
- Add new zoning shapefile to the preprocessing folder  
- Update the script to ingest the new layer  
- Ensure compatibility with metric XYZ  

---

## 🔗 Related Resources (Optional)  
Links to relevant data, documents, dashboards, or past issues.  

**Example:**  
- [Project Plan](https://...)  
- [Zoning Dataset](https://...)
